description: This file implements the WebRtcController class, which manages WebRTC command communication, including starting/stopping recording and taking screenshots, within the cuttlefish project.

classes.name: WebRtcController
classes.description: Controller class for managing WebRTC commands such as start/stop recording and screenshots.

methods.name: ResultSetup
methods.description: Initializes WebRTC command sockets and sets up communication channel.

methods.name: GetClientSocket
methods.description: Returns the client socket used for WebRTC communication.

methods.name: SendStartRecordingCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to start WebRTC recording.

methods.name: SendStopRecordingCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to stop WebRTC recording.

methods.name: SendScreenshotDisplayCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to display a screenshot on a specified display.
